My beans plot is very small, only like a small kitchen garden, so I cannot waste money on a whole bag of fertilizer for it — one bag of urea or DAP is too much for this piece and costs too much cash from my pocket. I will put some manure from the animals around the homestead because that one I get for free, and I will use seed I kept from last season since my beans did okay and buying certified seed at the agro-dealer is not worth it for such a small plot. Here in Mbeya the masika rains come well so I do not need to irrigate, and beans do not need much spraying if I weed them on time with my own hands. I am young and strong, so I will do the work myself with maybe a small help from my younger brother during weeding.
